query: Which route-level instruments (slot reallocations, slot auctions, airport capacity caps, exogenous airport closures, weather-driven runway constraints) plausibly satisfy exclusion, and how will we test first-stage strength?

response.query: Which route-level instruments (slot reallocations, slot auctions, airport capacity caps, exogenous airport closures, weather-driven runway constraints) plausibly satisfy exclusion, and how will we test first-stage strength?
response.answer: Slot reallocations, slot auctions, and weather-driven runway constraints plausibly satisfy exclusion. First-stage strength will be tested by examining the exogenous variation in these instruments.
